therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: HER2-normal early stage breast cancer patients
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: feasibility of completing eribulin portion without dose delay or reduction

subgroup_findings: No significant difference in feasibility between filgrastim as needed vs prophylactic filgrastim groups
results.dose_information: Eribulin mesylate 1.4mg/m2 for 4 cycles during 12 weeks, following dose dense doxorubicin and cyclophosphamide for 4 cycles during first 8 weeks

context.comparator: Two cohorts comparing filgrastim as needed vs prophylactic filgrastim
context.duration: 20 weeks treatment, followed by up to 3 years follow-up
